collectorReview.interpretation: Blob concatenates adjacent State A and Pointer lobe without a separator. Isometric combines hidden layers, button-like painted words and numerical readouts. Glass combines both faces, arrows and location/time metadata; the complete location/time stays in aria-description. The primary identifying copy is separately checked against actual Chrome names. Evervault glyph values are random decorative texture, not identifying human-language labels. Its visual low-contrast flags remain and are not claimed repaired by the speech-content change.

wholeCatalog.status: The complete unfiltered scans still exit 1. Raw counts are unchanged for the retained name/contrast rules; no node or rule is suppressed. Manual identifying-label/contrast reviews remain open.

remainingNames.assertionChange: One exact stable Glass name expectation gains the visible identifying copy. Every other assertion remains unchanged.
